baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered pair أَدْبَرَ / ٱسْتَكْبَرَ joins bodily reorientation to self-exaltation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning the back makes refusal spatial and visible; self-magnification supplies the status posture that sustains it. The sequence marked by ثُمَّ therefore presents one coordinated act rather than two unrelated faults.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the bodily movement that enacts refusal.
Grandeur and self-magnification supply the elevated posture that makes the withdrawal defiant.

changed_reading.before: He performed two generic negative acts: turning away and being arrogant.
changed_reading.after: He embodied refusal by turning his back and using self-elevation to hold that withdrawn position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَدْبَرَ can activate the د ب ر branch of considering outcomes, while ٱسْتَكْبَرَ activates rank and leadership.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ordinary withdrawal, the branch inventory permits a strategic shadow: the subject may be taking a calculated rearward position to preserve standing. This is a branch activation, not a replacement gloss for أَدْبَرَ.

activation_trace.role: Managing by considering outcomes supplies the exploratory possibility of a consequence-aware retreat.
Rank, honor, and leadership supply the social standing that the retreat may be designed to protect.

changed_reading.before: The turn is an unplanned recoil caused by arrogance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the turn is also a position-taking maneuver intended to preserve rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening imperative directs magnification toward the Lord, whereas the focus subject magnifies himself after withdrawing. The repeated root turns the focus into an object-reversal: the problem is not magnitude itself but its reassignment from the Lord to the self.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back supplies the pivot away from the orientation established by the opening command.
Self-magnification supplies the focus subject's rival claim to greatness.
Regarding something as great supplies the commanded outward object of magnification and exposes the focus reversal.

structural_cues: 74:3 places the root in an imperative whose object is the Lord; 74:23 returns the root in a reflexive form attached to the withdrawing subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root in these opposed grammatical relations; I infer a deliberate object-reversal, while the live alternative is that the two uses independently denote proper magnification and ordinary pride.

changed_reading.before: He simply becomes arrogant after turning away.
changed_reading.after: His self-magnification is a usurpation of the opening command's direction: he turns from magnifying the Lord to enlarging himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended wealth, lineage, present witnesses, and prepared ease form a social platform from which self-magnification can operate. The turn is thus not only private pride but defense of an already furnished public rank.

activation_trace.role: Nobility on both ancestral sides gives the turn an exploratory lineage and status inflection.
Rank, honor, and leadership supply the social position being asserted and defended.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies material capacity for an enlarged social self.
Sonship and lineage supply continuity and inherited standing to the status mechanism.
Presence with witnessing supplies an audience and visible support for public rank.
Preparing and smoothing an affair supplies the ease on which defensive self-importance rests.

structural_cues: 74:11-16 moves from being created alone through accumulated endowments to resistance, placing privilege before the focus sequence of refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, sons, their presence, prepared ease, and rank branches; I infer that these goods function as status capital motivating refusal, while they may alternatively be only the background against which ingratitude is judged.

changed_reading.before: Self-magnification is an isolated inner attitude.
changed_reading.after: Self-magnification is privilege-backed rank defense: he turns away to protect a socially furnished position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Internal rumination and deliberate estimation move into looking, facial contraction, bodily withdrawal, self-exaltation, and finally speech. The focus is the hinge at which calculated cognition becomes a public performance and a voiced claim.

activation_trace.role: Managing with an eye to outcomes supplies the strategic shadow that the preceding calculation activates.
Turning the back supplies the bodily decision point between inward assessment and outward declaration.
Self-magnification supplies the stance in which the calculated answer is publicly delivered.
The heart's repeated movement over a matter supplies the internal start of the decision process.
Managing by estimation and inspection supplies deliberate formulation rather than spontaneous reaction.
Directing sight or insight to perceive supplies the transition from inward calculation to inspection.
Facial contraction from distress or anger supplies the first visible output of the assessment.
A scowling face and intense aversion deepen the bodily performance immediately before the turn.
Bringing speech out in utterance supplies the public endpoint of the sequence.

structural_cues: The repeated ثُمَّ across 74:20-23 slows the stages, and فَقَالَ in 74:24 makes speech the immediate consequence of the focus posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered cognitive, visual, facial, postural, and verbal stages; I infer a causal production line from assessment to performance, while a materially live alternative is simple chronological narration without strategic design.

changed_reading.before: The turn is a sudden recoil caused by an already existing pride.
changed_reading.after: The turn and self-exaltation are the decision hinge through which prolonged calculation becomes performed refusal and then a public verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same turning-away root later belongs to night as it reaches its trailing end, followed by dawn uncovering, while the greatness root names the great warning. This cosmic sequence makes the human turn temporary and rescales his claimed greatness against a greater order.

activation_trace.role: Human turning of the back supplies the posture that the later cosmic recurrence recontextualizes.
Human self-magnification supplies the false scale corrected by the later naming of true greatness.
The end and trailing remainder of a thing make night’s retreat a phase that necessarily passes.
Removing a cover supplies dawn's disclosure after the receding darkness.
Greatness opposed to smallness supplies the scale against which the subject's self-enlargement shrinks.

structural_cues: 74:32-35 forms an oath sequence of moon, receding night, revealing dawn, and one of the great matters; it repeats both focus roots around a reversal from concealment to disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence and the contiguous night-to-dawn sequence; I infer an analogical judgment on the focus subject, while the alternative is that the cosmic oath and the earlier human acts remain rhetorically independent.

changed_reading.before: His turning away and self-magnification dominate the moment as if final.
changed_reading.after: His turn is a passing darkness before disclosure, and his manufactured greatness is reduced by the warning's actual scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later maps response as forward movement or falling back, then depicts turning one's side, recoiling, and fleeing. The focus turn becomes the compact individual onset of a larger retreat trajectory rather than a static attitude.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the first explicit rearward movement in the response trajectory.
Advancing forward supplies the positive pole against which the focus turn is located.
The rear or backward position supplies the explicit negative pole matching the focus orientation.
Turning one's side supplies a later collective bodily form of refusal.
Recoil and distancing extend the turn into active separation from the reminder.
Flight supplies the trajectory's terminal acceleration from withdrawal into escape.

structural_cues: The singular sequence at 74:21-24 later becomes a plural response image at 74:49-51, and 74:37 places both on an advance-or-retreat axis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated directional and bodily response images; I infer one escalating movement pattern from turn to collective flight, while the alternative is that the later animal comparison illustrates a separate audience.

changed_reading.before: أَدْبَرَ is a single localized gesture.
changed_reading.after: أَدْبَرَ initiates a response topology: choosing the rearward pole can intensify from turning aside into recoil and flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gestures are subsequently placed under an acquisition-and-pledge mechanism: what a self does is acquired to its account and holds that self as collateral. Withdrawal and pride therefore become self-binding acts, not passing expressions.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies the chosen act that can be carried forward to the self's account.
Self-exaltation supplies the stance that becomes consequential rather than merely expressive.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the action-to-account transfer by which conduct becomes one's own acquisition.
A pledge held against a right supplies the binding consequence that fixes the acquired act to the self.

structural_cues: 74:38 states a general act-to-self relation after 74:37's response choice and before the later retrospective account of conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning and collateral images; I infer that the focus gestures are instances of the conduct that binds their actor, while the alternative is that 74:38 states general accountability without singling out these gestures.

changed_reading.before: Turning away and self-exalting are transient displays.
changed_reading.after: They are acquired choices that fasten the actor to the consequences of the posture he adopts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the report-from-another branch is form-distant from ordinary أَدْبَرَ and must not replace 'turned away.' It remains anchored in the focus's د ب ر inventory and is activated by the immediately following claim that the message is transmitted speech; downstream prose should label it only as an exploratory lexical resonance of reattribution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The د ب ر branch attached to focus word 2 includes narrating a report from another after him.

activation_trace.role: Narrating a report from another supplies a branch-distant relay image within the focus root.
Transmitting a report until it becomes received tradition directly activates the relay image.
Speech brought into utterance supplies the human-source attribution that completes the relay claim.

changed_reading.before: He turns away and then labels the message inherited magic and human speech.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, his turn opens a reattribution maneuver: revelation is recast as merely relayed human speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The arrow-behind-the-target image is highly material and cannot be treated as the lexical sense of أَدْبَرَ. It remains valid as an anchored analogy because that image belongs to the focus root and follows explicit estimating and planning; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-triggered picture of a calculated answer that misses its aim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The د ب ر inventory for focus word 2 includes an arrow passing behind or beyond its target.

activation_trace.role: An arrow passing behind the target supplies the material image of overshooting after careful aim.
Planning through estimation and inspection supplies the deliberate aiming process that nevertheless fails.

changed_reading.before: His calculation ends in a physical turn away.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the calculated verdict overshoots the truth like an aimed arrow passing behind its target.

strongest_changes: The repeated ك ب ر root converts generic arrogance into a reversal of the opening command's object of magnification.
The 74:18-24 sequence makes the focus the hinge where calculation becomes facial, postural, and verbal performance.
The receding-night and revealing-dawn sequence makes the human turn temporary and rescales self-claimed greatness.
Later advance, retreat, turning aside, recoil, and flight place the focus gesture within an escalating response trajectory.
The earning-and-pledge mechanism makes the posture a self-binding choice rather than a passing display.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence did more than reinforce a gloss: it reassigned the object of greatness, converted private posture into social and verbal strategy, repeated the turn on a cosmic scale, and then traced its ethical consequences.
remaining_uncertainties: The privilege-to-rank-defense arrow is inferred from narrative order; the endowments may instead function only as evidence of ingratitude.
The cosmic sequence may intentionally judge the focus posture, but exact root recurrence alone does not prove the analogy.
The transmitted-report and missed-target outliers are branch activations, not proposed lexical translations of أَدْبَرَ.
